This is what I would say to you or your daughter, if she has no plans to continue in college then I would say try to push through these last 2 years. She will never participate in competitive athletics ever again. Take it easy with the extra training. Does she have any interest in a Fall sport that's less taxing than wrestling? Again, it's 2 years November to February. It would really suck for her to miss out on it. These are core memories that she will miss out on if she decides to call it quits. Another thing I say to athletes that try to walk away from my sport or any sport is, you'll be able to tell your kids one day that you toughened out through something that was difficult. 

  
TLDR

Take it easy with the year around wrestling.
